# Heterogeneous reference-array initializer fixture v3

This version keeps every initializer and helper from v2, but uses a simpler observer: it reads the one known non-empty element into an `Object` local, branches with `if`/`else` for null, prints its class name, then prints the side-effect trace. This removes unrelated loop/ternary/array-read recovery debt from the fixture. Earlier v2 sources, classes, raw streams, runner and manifest remain preserved in `openspec/changes/recover-heterogeneous-array-init/evidence/heterogeneous-array-initializers-v2/`.

The `factory` family is the positive type-proof input. The `direct` family is a complete, verifier-valid constructor/array-store composition control; its refusal is not a negative assignment-compatibility claim. Each family has six top-level classes, compiled together for both JDK legs with explicit empty classpath and sourcepath.

The earlier v3 manifests are preserved under `openspec/changes/recover-heterogeneous-array-init/evidence/heterogeneous-array-initializers-v3-initial/` and `.../heterogeneous-array-initializers-v3-pathfix/`. The final manifest records the actual prefixed raw-stream paths and is `build-manifest-v3-final.json` (SHA-256 `b63f60f00a2fd571436edaa1d5f2d8e1e653224f0a608118366dce93ca5237b3`), produced by the self-contained `build_fixture_v3_final.py` (SHA-256 `faac1b7a77f1fe4507fed2522374ba5bce5b6bac0b356892bc74afdd2b9c9675`). `source-plan-v3.md` has SHA-256 `20899becf9429e6bce68c20da5750ea8158376f7b146c6069828e8f326de05e9`.

Both original compiler legs for both families compiled all six classes and passed `-Xverify:all`. Their deterministic stdout SHA-256 is `fd3a20051507b79c6537ccc6fcc24a40fb1bb10e7fda4ea01ae06a08fdc0a71b`; stderr is empty. The saved build manifest records exact argv, tool identities, raw streams, source hashes, class hashes and `aastore` BCIs.

The frozen candidate CLI also rendered all six classes for all four legs. Factory source compiled in isolation and ran with exact original stdout/stderr matches. Direct-new source retained explicit bytecode fallback and did not compile, preserving the known composition boundary. The permanent independent root replay is recorded in `openspec/changes/recover-heterogeneous-array-init/results/candidate-v1-fixture-v3/manifest.json` (SHA-256 `d3dd331861d79d32cc64b2fd2e2c3677606868d54767e157fa99e5db7f508b87`). Its sibling `candidate-v1-fixture-v3-root-verification.json` verifies all six input/generated class sets, isolated argv, 246 file hashes, exact stdout/stderr, and provenance for all 50 positive initializer stores. The frozen CLI SHA-256 is `0ebf4e6189c02d1d84072c9aeacd380303e71e6885f95408e054e8f843154f79`.

The four integration tests and both workspace seeds passed, including missing intermediate-header and budget/cancellation controls. See the change's `verification-root.md` and `results/local-gates-root-verification.json` for full local gates and retained historical failures. Direct constructors remain unaccepted and have their own planned proof-composition change.
